preservation_rule: The original acceptance artifact is retained unchanged as historical provenance.
unsupported_claim: complete follow-up lifecycle and duplicate-search prevention
finding: An actionable open follow-up could be selected into an exact follow-up search, but the source registry row was never transitioned or linked to that consuming search. After the search completed, the source row remained open and search-eligible, allowing the same work to be scheduled repeatedly.
production_impact: This violates durable follow-up disposition, explicit follow-up relationships, and the requirement to avoid duplicate searches. EXO-Hunter must not be called PROD again until scheduling and terminal disposition are append-only, related to the consuming search, migration-safe, and verified.
corrective_plan: Add append-only follow-up lifecycle events and parent-child recommendation relationships.
Atomically transition selected registry rows from open to scheduled with the consuming search ID.
Keep failed work scheduled for exact-search resume; close successful work and defer no-data outcomes.
Reject stale follow-up candidates transactionally so no duplicate pending search survives.
Migrate the production database, verify the real deferred row and event integrity, then issue replacement acceptance evidence.
